dataset_name: Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions

citation.primary: Hongn, A., Bosch, N., Prado, L. R., & Bonomini, M. P. (2025). Wearable Device Dataset from Induced Stress and Structured Exercise Sessions (version 1.0.0). PhysioNet. https://doi.org/10.13026/zzf8-xv61
citation.companion: Goldberger, A., Amaral, L., Glass, L., Hausdorff, J., Ivanov, P. C., Mark, R., ... & Stanley, H. E. (2000). PhysioBank, PhysioToolkit, and PhysioNet: Components of a new research resource for complex physiologic signals. Circulation [Online]. 101 (23), pp. e215-e220.

license.name: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0 (ODC-By)

download_record.download_method: curl (resumable, -C -) to data/raw/dataset.zip, then Python zipfile extraction to data/raw/extracted/
download_record.zip_integrity_test: unzip -tq dataset.zip -> 'No errors detected in compressed data of dataset.zip.'

extraction_record.note_on_708_vs_709: SHA256SUMS.txt itself is the 709th file and does not list its own hash; all 708 files it does list were verified.

integrity_verification.method: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.txt (the dataset's own official checksum manifest, shipped inside the archive by PhysioNet)
integrity_verification.result: ALL 708 FILES VERIFIED EXACTLY AGAINST THE DATASET'S OWN PUBLISHED CHECKSUMS. Zero mismatches, zero missing files.
integrity_verification.log_file_note: Verification log was empty on success (sha256sum -c --quiet suppresses OK lines and prints only failures); an empty log with exit code 0 confirms zero failures.

dataset_structure.sensor_file_format: Empatica E4 format: row 1 = UTC start timestamp (repeated per column), row 2 = sampling rate in Hz (repeated per column, N/A for IBI.csv and tags.csv), rows 3+ = raw samples.

sampling_rates_hz_as_read_from_files.IBI: irregular (inter-beat interval, no fixed header rate)
sampling_rates_hz_as_read_from_files.tags: event marker timestamps, no fixed header rate

subject_roster.source: subject-info.csv (own 'Info' column), restricted to rows matching the strict subject-id pattern S## or f## -- the file also contains a trailing footnote/reference block in the same column, which was excluded

STRESS.note: 36 subjects, but f14 is split into f14_a/f14_b (Bluetooth disconnection), yielding 38 directories for 37 distinct subjects' worth of coverage minus S12 excluded below -- see missing_or_problematic_recordings

AEROBIC.note: S12 and f14-f18 (5 female subjects) did not perform this activity at all, per subject-info.csv's own 'Aerobic Exercise' column ('-'); S11 is split into S11_a/S11_b

ANAEROBIC.note: f14-f18 (5 female subjects) did not perform this activity at all, per subject-info.csv's own 'Anaerobic Exercise' column ('-'); S16 is split into S16_a/S16_b

missing_or_problematic_recordings.source_note: The subset below is transcribed VERBATIM from the dataset's own data_constraints.txt (cp1252-encoded, bullet char 0x95) and subject-info.csv footnotes -- nothing paraphrased or silently dropped.

documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.subject: S02
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.issue: Duplicated signals: ACC row 49545, BVP row 99091, EDA/TEMP row 6195 onward are duplicates of earlier data.
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.measured_confirmation: STRESS/S02/ACC.csv has 99086 data rows total -- consistent with duplication of roughly the back half of the file.

documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.subject: f07
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.issue: Wristband dock never removed; only EDA and ACC are scientifically valid. BVP and TEMP files are physically present but not valid signal.
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.note: SSM pipeline only consumes ACC, so this has no downstream effect.

documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.subject: f14
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.issue: Bluetooth connection lost mid-session; split into f14_a and f14_b.

documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.subject: S03
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.issue: Protocol ended early (subject reached 90 rpm before target).

documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.subject: S07
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.issue: Protocol ended early (subject reached 95 rpm before target).

documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.subject: S11
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.issue: Bluetooth connection lost mid-session; split into S11_a and S11_b.

documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.subject: S06
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.issue: Protocol ended early; last sprint interval missing.

documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.subject: S16
documented_quality_issues_data_constrain.issue: Bluetooth connection lost mid-session; split into S16_a and S16_b.

recordings_included_in_experiment: TO BE FINALIZED IN experiments/experiment_01_dataset_validation output once DECISIONS_REQUIRED.md items 1-2 are confirmed; provisionally: all 36 subjects across all activities they performed, with S02/STRESS truncated at its documented duplication row (Decision 2, provisional default), and f14/S11/S16 modeled as single continuous sessions with the measured real gap inserted (Decision 1, provisional default).
recordings_excluded_and_why: AEROBIC/S12 and AEROBIC+ANAEROBIC/f14-f18 excluded because the subject did not perform that activity at all (subject-info.csv, not a data quality problem). No subject is excluded due to unresolved data-quality issues at this stage; S02/STRESS is included in truncated form (see Decision 2) rather than excluded.
provenance_of_this_manifest: Every field above was either read directly from a file shipped inside the official dataset (subject-info.csv, data_constraints.txt, SHA256SUMS.txt, README.txt) or measured directly from the raw sensor files by experiments/experiment_01_dataset_validation/build_inventory.py. No field was estimated or invented.
